cited.quote: Animal Mobile Medical Ambulances available in all the Districts ensure that emergencies in remote areas are attended to swiftly

rationale: C2 only describes existing animal mobile ambulances in the districts; no GO, scheme or step creating new veterinary hospitals with an ambulance service appears. Other extracts concern human ambulances or other subjects.

cited.quote: distribution of fertilizers and pesticides, establishment of Agri-Clinic, Micro-Irrigation service

rationale: C5 only says the government will facilitate and train agriculture graduates in activities including Agri-Clinic establishment, a plan in a policy note. No GO or launch of agro clinics for pest study and knowledge dissemination is shown. Other extracts are about weather advisories and research stations.

cited.quote: Ensuring supply of drinking water to each house directly in both urban and rural areas will be the highest priority

rationale: C3 is a statement of intent only. C1 and C2 describe Chennai water sources and desalination projects, not new household pipes in all corporation areas. No official step for this commitment is shown.

cited.quote: The coverage shall also include pre-existing diseases which have been included in the approved treatments
Surgery, Chemotherapy, Radiotherapy and Immunotherapy for all Malignancies including inpatient procedures for diagnosis

rationale: C1 is the GO of 2021-06-29 implementing the New Health Insurance Scheme 2021 for employees, covering cancer, heart and kidney conditions from day one with an enhanced Rs.10 lakh limit. It covers government employees only, and nothing shows regularisation of both schemes or 100 percent cover. Partial.

cited.quote: sufficient number of musicians are being appointed by the respective temples

rationale: C2 mentions only compassionate appointments of 11 heirs and musicians appointed by temples. No order or scheme to appoint 25000 youth as temple employees appears in any extract.

No extract concerns a Water Management Authority or bargaining for inter-state water shares. C1 to C3 cover coastal, wetland and forest authorities; C4 and C5 cover urban development authorities for Hosur and Coimbatore.

cited.quote: The Cooperatives have built a wide distribution network in the State and run majority of the Fair Price Shops

rationale: C4 describes fair price shops mostly run by cooperatives, as existing arrangement. No order bringing ration shops under a single department is shown. C1 and C2 are COVID notifications, C3 and C5 unrelated.

cited.quote: Habitat improvement activities and 62 maintenance of barriers such as elephant proof trenches
after careful examination, issue orders for enhancing the compensation from Rs.4.00 lakhs

rationale: C3 is a GO of 2021-11-03 raising compensation for deaths from wildlife conflict, which is relief after deaths rather than prevention. C4 reports barriers already set up, ongoing activity in a policy note. No new order or guideline to prevent elephant-conflict deaths is shown.

cited.quote: Hanging Type for all animals including elephants (For a length of 566 m)
barriers such as elephant proof trenches and solar fences to prevent human- wildlife conflicts have been set up

rationale: C5 is a GO of 2021-10-22 sanctioning subsidised solar fencing units, with a hanging type for elephants, a barrier measure. C2 reports elephant-proof trenches and solar fences set up. Fencing is aimed at farmers, so relevance is moderate.

cited.quote: over head line (OH) to underground cable (UG) have been taken up in the Chennai city and extended areas

rationale: C2 reports overhead-to-underground conversion taken up in Chennai at Rs.993.32 crore with loan assistance, works under way. It names Chennai and delta areas, not all cities, and gives no GO or operational date. Only a policy note supports it.

cited.quote: To demonstrate and popularize the use of farm ponds and other agro techniques for water conservation in drylands.
a special scheme for dry land farmers, is implemented at an outlay of Rs.146.64 crore during 2021-22

rationale: C5 is a GO of 2021-10-28 sanctioning dryland water-conservation technique demonstrations, and C1 reports a dry land development scheme with micro watershed structures. Nothing is shown for wasteland development, so only the dry land part is covered.

cited.quote: The lumpsum amount payable under Tamil Nadu Government Servants’ Family Security Fund Scheme shall be enhanced to Rs.5,00,000/-

rationale: C1 is the GO of 2021-09-01 raising the family security lumpsum to Rs.5 lakh for employees dying in service, matching the Rs.5 lakh fund. No extract shows compassionate employment for these families or coverage of those dismissed, so only part is shown.

cited.quote: Those who are affected with 40% and above are eligible from January 2022

rationale: C3 concerns a maintenance allowance scheme with a 40 percent criterion, not a change of the disability threshold under the Persons with Disabilities Act. C1 and C5 are an equal opportunity policy GO. No step on the threshold change is shown.

cited.quote: MTC has planned to introduce CNG (Compressed Natural Gas) / LNG (Liquefied Natural Gas) Buses

rationale: C1 says only that the Chennai transport corporation has planned CNG/LNG buses. C3 and C5 concern a KfW project for diesel BS-VI and electric buses. No order for CNG buses in towns and corporations is shown.

cited.quote: multi-tier cropping system will be implemented by cultivating various crops including fodder grass

rationale: C4 is a budget speech announcement of a multi-tier cropping system in coconut gardens, a statement of intent. The GO in C1 and C2 sanctions only an integrated nutrient management package, not layer farming. No order introducing layer farming is shown.

cited.quote: multi-tier cropping system will be implemented by cultivating various crops including fodder grass

rationale: C5 only announces multi-tier cropping in a budget speech. No extract shows a training programme on layer farming for coconut farmers; C1 and C3 are a nutrient management GO.

cited.quote: This Government will take all necessary steps to revive the Central Institute of Classical Tamil in Chennai.

rationale: C2 is a budget speech statement of intent and C3 a governor address promise. C1 describes land allotted and a building nearing completion without a dated new measure. No dedicated GO, scheme or law for reviving the institute or its autonomy is shown.

cited.quote: There are 64 Coir Industrial Co-operative Societies functioning with 10,887 members / workers

rationale: C1 describes existing coir industrial cooperative societies and coir clusters in other districts. No direct procurement programme for coir products in Salem, Peravurani and Pattukottai is shown. C5 concerns livelihood parks for SHGs, a different scheme.

cited.quote: This Government will also urge the Union Government to make necessary laws and amendments to grant Indian citizenship

rationale: C3 is a Governor address statement of intent to urge the Union on citizenship, not a formal step such as a resolution or letter. C1 shows only an advisory committee announcement. No formal advocacy step on including Sri Lanka is shown.
